title: Set up your domain in Office 365
description: Learn more about Office 365 domains at https://support.office.com/article/28343f3a-dcee-41b6-9b97-5b0f4999b7ef Learn more about Office 365 at http://products.office.com/en-us/business/compare-office-365-for-business-plans/?=SOC_YT_SMBOpt_OfficeSku_domain  To have a personalized business email address in Office 365, you set up a domain name to use with email and other services. The domains setup wizard steps you through confirming that you own the domain, making sure users with email addresses on the domain will keep getting their mail, and finally, setting up the DNS records for your domain.   With an Office 365 subscription, you can edit and create new documents on your devices. Microsoft Office 365 delivers the power of cloud productivity to businesses of all sizes, helping save time, money, and free up valued resources. Office 365 combines the familiar Microsoft Office desktop suite with cloud-based versions of Microsoft's next-generation communications and collaboration services—including Microsoft Exchange Online, Microsoft SharePoint Online, Office Online, and Microsoft Skype for Business Online—to help users be productive from virtually anywhere through the Internet.

asr.full_text: Office 365 lets you add your custom domain so you can convert your email address to your business name. A step-by-step wizard guides you through the process. Let's get started. I want to use our business domain name, cohowineinc.com, for my email and other services, so I need to add the domain to Office 365. In the Office 365 admin center, in the left column, I choose Domains, then Add Domain. Setting up my domain will take three steps. First, Office 365 needs me to prove that I own the domain,. Which prevents someone else from using it without permission. I'll click Let's get started. Now I type in my domain. To prove that I own the domain, I need to add something called a TXT record at my domain's DNS. Host. When Office 365 finds the TXT record, this will confirm that the domain belongs to me. I'm. Going to copy the TXT value from this page now, so I can use it later to create the record. Office 365 already knows where my domain is registered, in this case it's enum. I can get. Step-by-step instructions for adding the record I need with a single click. Click. I sign in at Enom, and go to the page where I can add records. For Enom, that's right here. But your domain registrar may look a little different. Here I paste in that txt value I copied earlier, and save the record. After I add the record at eNOM, I wait a few minutes for Office 365 to confirm it. Now I've proved that I own the domain. In step two, I'll update and add email addresses. Changing our email addresses now helps make sure that we won't lose any emails once they. Start coming to Office 365. I click Update Selected Users, and I see a confirmation that my users were updated. I see a message telling me to sign out and sign back in to complete the change, so I. Click Sign Out and sign back in with my updated email address, ron at cohowineinc.com. My password stays the same. Now I could add other people who have cohowineinc.com email addresses to Office 365, but since Alex. And I are the only Coho Wine employees, I'll choose Skip This Step. In step 3, I'll complete the setup at Enom to connect my Office 365 services to my domain. First, I choose how to set up the records for my domain. I already have a website, and I want to update my own records, so I'll choose No, and then. Next. I choose the services that I want to use, and then click Next to get ready to set up. DNS for the services. There are more records I need to add at Enom to make my email and other services work with. My domain in Office 365. Let's start with the MX record for my email. I'll copy the values from here to make it easier. I sign in again at ENAW and go to the page where I can add email records. I'll select Email Settings, then User MX. Again, this might look a little different for your domain registrar. I enter the information for the MX record, pasting the value that I copied earlier, and. Save the record. I'll do the same for the other records that I need to add. Copy the values from Office 365. And paste them into new records at Enum. If I need extra guidance,. I can get step-by-step instructions. By clicking these links. After I'm done, I click OK. I've added the records. And I'm all set. All incoming email messages sent to cohowineinc.com. Will arrive in our Office 365 inboxes. Learn more at Office365.com.
